Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Instagram Stories' emoji slider sticker - dragging the emoji handle along its track pops a giant springy version of the emoji that grows with the drag position, live over the story canvas.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
The Instagram Story composer on a purple canvas: an "Ask a question..."-style sticker card holding the emoji slider - a thin track with a heart-eyes emoji as its draggable handle. The keyboard sits open below with an emoji suggestions row above it. While dragging, a giant version of the emoji floats above the sticker, scaling with the handle's position.

## Motion spec
Pattern: emoji slider with giant springy preview, gesture-driven.
- The handle tracks the horizontal drag 1:1 along the track, the track's filled portion tinting behind it.
- On touch-down, the giant emoji springs in above the sticker (scale 0.3 to 1, spring stiffness 350 damping 15, a juicy overshoot), floating with a slight bob.
- The giant emoji scales with the slider value (0.8x at the left end to 1.6x at the right) and wiggles (rotation plus/minus 6 degrees) as the value changes.
- On release, the handle settles with a small bounce (spring stiffness 400 damping 18) and the giant emoji shrinks away (scale to 0.3, 200ms, ease-in).
- The sticker's own emoji handle keeps a subtle idle pulse when untouched.

## Calibration
- The giant preview is the same emoji as the handle - swapping the handle's emoji swaps the preview.
- The preview never blocks the track: it floats above, translucent to touches.

## Reduced motion
Preview scales without bounce or wiggle.

## Don't miss
- The slider sits inside the story sticker card, which stays put while the handle moves.
- The springy overshoot on preview entry is the personality - keep it big.
